description: This file defines the UserSettingsDelegate class, which manages user settings and notifications via the IUserSettings interface, including handling subscriptions, retrieving and setting various user preferences, and dispatching related events.

classes.name: UserSettingsDelegate
classes.description: A delegate class managing user settings and notifications, interfacing with IUserSettings, handling subscriptions, and dispatching events.

classes.name: UserSettingsNotificationHandler
classes.description: Inner class implementing IUserSettings::INotification to handle user setting change events and dispatch corresponding notifications.

methods.name: HandleSubscription
methods.description: Manages subscription to user setting notifications, registering or removing notifications based on 'listen' flag.

methods.name: HandleEvent
methods.description: Checks if an event is a valid user setting event and handles subscription accordingly.

methods.name: GetUserSettingsInterface
methods.description: Retrieves the IUserSettings interface, querying via the shell if necessary.

methods.name: GetVoiceGuidance
methods.description: Retrieves the current voice guidance setting as a JSON string.

methods.name: GetAudioDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the current audio description setting as a JSON string.

methods.name: GetAudioDescriptionsEnabled
methods.description: Retrieves whether audio descriptions are enabled as a JSON string.

methods.name: GetHighContrast
methods.description: Retrieves the high contrast setting as a JSON string.

methods.name: GetCaptions
methods.description: Retrieves the captions setting as a JSON string.

methods.name: SetVoiceGuidance
methods.description: Sets the voice guidance enabled state.

methods.name: SetAudioDescriptionsEnabled
methods.description: Sets the audio description enabled state.

methods.name: SetCaptions
methods.description: Sets the captions enabled state.

methods.name: SetVoiceGuidanceRate
methods.description: Sets the rate for voice guidance.

methods.name: SetVoiceGuidanceHints
methods.description: Sets whether voice guidance hints are enabled.

methods.name: GetVoiceGuidanceRate
methods.description: Retrieves the voice guidance rate.

methods.name: GetVoiceGuidanceHints
methods.description: Retrieves whether voice guidance hints are enabled.

methods.name: GetPresentationLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the presentation language, returning the language code before '-' if present.

methods.name: GetLocale
methods.description: Retrieves the full locale string.

methods.name: SetLocale
methods.description: Sets the presentation language/locale.

methods.name: GetPreferredAudioLanguages
methods.description: Retrieves preferred audio languages as a JSON array.

methods.name: GetPreferredCaptionsLanguages
methods.description: Retrieves preferred captions languages as a JSON array, defaulting to ["eng"] if unavailable.

methods.name: SetPreferredAudioLanguages
methods.description: Sets preferred audio languages from a JSON array or string.

methods.name: SetPreferredCaptionsLanguages
methods.description: Sets preferred captions languages from a JSON array or string.
